studioui.new.title: New manga
studioui.new.heading: Open a new manuscript
studioui.new.intro: Set the story boundary once. MangaVeyra will queue a structured script that you can inspect and edit before any page work begins.
studioui.new.story_help: Write an original premise or adapt one plain-text source.
studioui.new.premise_hint: Required for an original premise. Do not add source text in this mode.
studioui.new.premise_placeholder: A night courier hears a harbor bell that should have vanished with the old city.
studioui.new.source_hint: For adaptation, paste text here or upload one .txt file, not both.
studioui.new.production_help: These choices shape the script brief; they do not lock later page design.
studioui.new.pages_hint: A planning target from 1 to 256 pages.
studioui.new.submit_help: The project and chapter are saved before generation. If the job cannot start, you can retry from the story screen.
studioui.new.brief_body: The next step produces scenes, panels, camera direction, dialogue, and sound effects as editable structured data.
studioui.new.private_source: Adaptation text stays private project material and is never shown on the dashboard.
studioui.new.error.title: Enter a project title of 160 characters or fewer.
studioui.new.error.chapter_title: Enter a chapter title of 160 characters or fewer.
studioui.new.error.mode: Choose an original premise or an adaptation.
studioui.new.error.premise: Enter a premise of 4,000 characters or fewer.
studioui.new.error.premise_source: Original-premise mode cannot include adaptation text.
studioui.new.error.source_one: Provide exactly one source: pasted text or one .txt file.
studioui.new.error.source_size: Source text must be 1 MiB or smaller.
studioui.new.error.source_utf8: Source text must be valid UTF-8.
studioui.new.error.source_empty: The uploaded text file is empty.
studioui.new.error.upload: The source upload could not be read.
studioui.new.error.pages: Target pages must be a number from 1 to 256.
studioui.new.error.invalid: The project details are not valid. Review the fields and try again.
studioui.new.queued: The first script job is queued.
studioui.new.chapter_failed: Project saved, but the chapter was not created
studioui.new.recovery: Open the project and create its first chapter to continue.
studioui.chapter.empty_body: Create a chapter to recover this project and continue to script generation.
studioui.chapter.error.title: Enter a chapter title of 160 characters or fewer.
studioui.chapter.error.create: The chapter could not be created from those details.
studioui.story.read_only: You can read this chapter, but only an owner, writer, or editor can generate or change its script.
studioui.generate.title: Prepare the first script
studioui.generate.body: Generation creates a structured manuscript. Nothing is autosaved after you begin editing it.
studioui.generate.active: A script job is already active for this chapter.
studioui.generate.exists: This chapter already has a script.
studioui.generate.locked: This chapter is locked and cannot be changed.
studioui.generate.no_provider: No text provider is available. Check Models or use the built-in placeholder.
studioui.generate.local_only: Local-only mode blocked the selected remote route.
studioui.generate.spend_limit: The configured remote-spend limit has been reached.
studioui.generate.approval: This remote action needs human approval.
studioui.generate.bad_input: The script brief is not valid.
studioui.generate.provider_auth: The text provider connection is not authorized.
studioui.generate.try_again: Review the model connection, then try again.
studioui.job.queued_detail: The script job is queued. This status checks again every two seconds while the page is open.
studioui.job.running_detail: The current attempt is building scenes and panels.
studioui.job.done_detail: Return to the manuscript to review the persisted result.
studioui.job.failed_detail: The script could not be generated. The project and chapter are still saved.
studioui.job.timeout_detail: The provider or worker did not finish in time. You can retry safely.
studioui.job.safety_detail: The provider declined this request under its safety rules.
studioui.job.input_detail: The saved story brief could not be processed.
studioui.job.capacity_detail: The worker did not have enough capacity for this attempt.
studioui.job.canceled_detail: This job was canceled before completion.
studioui.job.retry_state: Only failed or canceled script jobs can be retried.
studioui.script.label: Persisted manuscript
studioui.script.title: Script editor
studioui.script.no_autosave: Changes are not autosaved. Save changes explicitly before leaving this page.
studioui.dialogue.caption: Caption
studioui.script.error.validation: Some script fields are not valid. Your submitted text is still shown below.
studioui.script.unsaved: Your unsaved values are still visible
studioui.script.conflict_help: Reload the latest revision before applying these changes again.
studioui.script.locked: The chapter was locked before these changes could be saved.
studioui.generate.changed: The manuscript changed while this request was being prepared. Reload the chapter and try again.
studioui.job.retry_blocked: Retrying would fail the same way. Fix the cause shown above, then generate a new script.
studioui.job.spend_limit_detail: The monthly remote-spend limit was reached. Ask an admin to raise it, or generate again after it resets.
studioui.job.local_only_detail: Local-only mode blocked the remote route. Generate again to plan a local route.
studioui.job.no_provider_detail: No text provider could serve this request. Check Models, then generate again.
studioui.job.provider_auth_detail: The text provider rejected its connection key. Replace the key in Models, then generate again.
studioui.job.provider_refused_detail: The text provider declined this request under its usage policy.
studioui.job.rate_limited_detail: The text provider is limiting requests right now. Retry in a few minutes.
studioui.job.bad_output_detail: The model returned a script that failed validation, even after one repair. Retry or generate again.
studioui.job.upstream_detail: The text provider did not respond correctly. Retry in a moment.
studioui.job.approval_detail: This remote action needs human approval before it can run.
